name: OpenSanctions (licensed bulk data, screening API, web search)
tier_rationale: OpenSanctions Datenbanken GmbH, an established company with published licensing terms and a business offering (A8 trusted); P222 and P231 record tier trusted.

reliability.justification: Curated consolidation of official sanctions lists and PEP sources with per-record provenance; name matches are screening candidates, never confirmations.

opensanctions.description: OpenSanctions API key (Authorization: ApiKey header only, never in URLs)
opensanctions.plan_hint: the company's OpenSanctions commercial licence (in-house Screening licence or bulk data licence) recorded in the registry and licence_allow (P222); the free path is never used under corporate

bulk_licensed.title: OpenSanctions bulk datasets (default collection targets and index) under a bulk data licence

terms.quote: Licence (A1): OpenSanctions data is CC BY-NC 4.0 (class 'noncommercial'); this module uses only the business-licensed path, registered as class 'license'. The free data and API path is never used under corporate.

bulk_licensed.notes: Quote: binding council text (P222 cond 1). data.opensanctions.org/datasets/latest/default/ (index.json, targets) through the dataset manager (`v3lum data update opensanctions`, never mid-scan), matched locally with core/namematch.py (disclosure 'none'); bulk datasets are never downloaded without the bulk licence (P222; research C0519).
bulk_licensed.licensed_alternative: An OpenSanctions bulk data licence recorded in licence_allow; P219 sanctions_lists (OFAC, UN, EU official lists) covers official sanctions offline without it.

screening_api.title: OpenSanctions API /match and /search under a Screening licence

terms.quote: It runs only when the company holds an OpenSanctions commercial licence (in-house Screening licence or bulk data licence) recorded in the provider registry and licence_allow; otherwise it is skipped under the corporate profile with reason_code 'licence'.

screening_api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P222 cond 2). api.opensanctions.org /match and /search with requires_keys ('opensanctions'), key only in the Authorization header, a monthly query budget in config with a hard stop and QUOTA status, no automatic credit purchase; 401 without a key -> NEEDS_KEY; 401/403/429, timeouts, 5xx and error-in-200 mean could not verify and are never cached (P222).
screening_api.licensed_alternative: An OpenSanctions in-house Screening licence recorded in licence_allow.

web_search.title: OpenSanctions web search www.opensanctions.org/search (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: The opensanctions.org website stays a manual link in P231 (their FAQ: free to use in a browser).

web_search.notes: Quote: binding council text (P222 cond 7). Manual links www.opensanctions.org/search/?q= (research C0539, P231); routine screening needs the licensed P222 path. V3LUM never fetches pivot links itself (P311).

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G10-1, p2-G14-2, p3-G10-1: batches only extend it (opensanctions__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). P219 sanctions_lists lists these hosts but declares no source here (legal floor: the CC BY-NC hosts belong to P222 only); a free-path source, if ever wanted for the research profile, is added by extension with class noncommercial. No quota block: the monthly query budget lives in config with a hard stop (P222) until the licence's figures are recorded here. opensanctions.org redirects to www.opensanctions.org (observed 2026-11-26).
